title: Tip Calculator
h1: Tip Calculator — Split Bill and Calculate Tips Instantly
seoTitle: Free Tip Calculator — Calculate Tips and Split Bills
description: Calculate the tip amount and total for any bill. Split the cost between any number of people. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Enter the bill amount, choose a tip percentage and the number of people sharing the bill. Instantly see the tip, total and amount per person.
blurb: Calculate tips and split restaurant bills fairly — free and private.
howItWorks: Enter the total bill amount before tip.
Set the tip percentage you want to leave (common values are 15%, 18% or 20%).
Enter how many people are splitting the bill, then press Calculate tip.
examples: A $45.80 bill with 18% tip for 2 people shows the tip amount, total and share per person.
Use 20% on a $120 dinner for 4 friends to see exactly what each person owes.
Leave the people field at 1 for a simple tip calculation without splitting.

faq.q: Is the calculation done on a server?
faq.a: No. Everything runs in your browser. Your bill amount is never sent anywhere.
In many places 15% is standard, 18–20% is generous, and 10% is for average service. Adjust to match local custom.

faq.q: Can I split an uneven bill?
faq.a: This tool splits the final total equally. For uneven shares, calculate the total first, then divide manually.
